name: George Washington State Campground and Management Area

fees.note: $18 a night for a Rhode Island resident, $36 for a non-resident (tier 3). $8.75 reservation fee. 2027 reservations are on hold while Rhode Island DEM picks a new reservation provider (riparks.ri.gov, 2026-10-12). Rhode Island's fee regulation, read 2026-10-12; the booking site charged the same for October 2026 nights.

source: https://rules.sos.ri.gov/regulations/Part/250-100-00-8 (250-RICR-100-00-8, 'Camping - Daily Site Reservations' tiers, read 2026-10-12) + rhodeislandstateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 253123 (per-site prices for 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-24, read 2026-10-12)
